subject: A writer computes the right promotion status and the FROZEN contract has no channel to carry it
question: ka_graha_sancara.py:82 computes 'status = success if health == healthy else error' and never uses it, because WriterResult has no status field. The writer ran its probe, got 'unhealthy', wrote that verdict to asset_registry, computed the correct status — and the orchestrator lit the asset 32ms later. CLAUDE.md §N.2 — the writer contract is FROZEN; a writer that 'seems to need' a contract change is P3

options: (1) Add an optional status/health field to WriterResult so a writer can veto its own promotion. Smallest change that closes the class, but it is a FROZEN-contract change and every writer inherits the new surface.

(2) Have the promotion predicate read asset_registry.service_health for service-kind assets, leaving WriterResult untouched. No contract change; but it special-cases services and puts the orchestrator in the business of reading registry columns.
(3) Leave it. The verdict is stored and visible; only the promotion ignores it. Cheapest, and dishonest in exactly the way this campaign exists to remove.

I lean to option 2 as the smaller blast radius, since it changes no writer and no frozen type, but I hold that loosely and would not act on it. NOT URGENT: the operator surface is already fixed (T34), the verdict is stored and correct, and no rung that owns these assets is open. It should be settled before R3 opens, since that is when ka_graha_sancara is repaired for real.
work_completed_around_it: D-32 corrects D-26's causal claim so the campaign does not believe the build gate was closed today; T34 closed the operator-surface half and pinned M3's half with an M3-DEFERRED test. Nothing is blocked.
